report_entries.root_cause: _estimate_active_params uses soft depth_mask (STE probabilities). During training, ALL layers execute (STE blend computes everything then masks). The formula measures routing INTENT, not actual EXECUTION. The config.estimate_active_parameters() heuristic additionally multiplies by target_active_ratio (0.1 default), making it even more inaccurate.
report_entries.fix: Add mode parameter: mode='intent' (current, inference planning) or mode='execution' (training reality). In 'execution' mode during training, report 100% of HASS params. At inference, use hard mask to count only executed layers. Document both modes.
